scope: Independent pre-repair user-constant compiler and allocation diagnosis; no paired source acceptance or family closure.
result: originals retained; compiler boundary repair required

findings: Legal constant/property/nullsafe/static first-class callable expressions were incorrectly rejected as static invalid operations. Existing classconstant/classname lookup stayed explicitly pending.
Dynamic classconstant initializer had the wrong static diagnostic; static::X remained pending despite native static rejection.

First wrapper attempted execution after a successful constant compilation on an intentionally unpaired compiler-only candidate. Its exact interpreter_failure and closure are preserved; the complete rerun only checks compiler phases.

allocation_observations: Empty and one-byte results can be refcounted. Binary bitwise string shortcuts require both operands to have length one; remaining binary bitwise string results allocate.
When both concatenation operands are empty, the right operand class survives. Opposite empty operand orders can change repeated-warning counts.
Empty array union/unpack results allocate. Runtime null-to-array cast yields the shared empty array, while compile-folded null cast creates an allocated empty array.
Interning a stored root string does not recursively intern literal array children. Named constant aliases and deferred concatenation preserve different long-string classes despite equal bytes.
reference_observations: Known constant-DIM reference sends reject statically; forward sends report a runtime temporary-write Error.
Reference foreach over a constant array mutates a temporary copy. Value-call and foreach-copy witnesses preserve the constant through local nested reference writes.
namespace_observation: Runtime normalizes namespace prefixes only; terminal constant names and import aliases remain case-sensitive. Compile-time seen-symbol spelling is a separate pinned behavior.
pending: Source-derived allocation transfer and source-root/public-state guards require independent review on a frozen paired implementation. No value-only cacheability heuristic is accepted.
